tolerance.null: BIT_IDENTICAL FOR THE STORED BYTES; a REGENERATION is held to a MEASURED FLOOR instead, and the two are different claims. The file on disk does not change by itself, so a sha256 that moves means something wrote it -- that is what this target watches, and bit-identity is the right criterion for it. But the pooled null CANNOT be regenerated bit-for-bit, by any version of the code including the one that wrote the baseline. THE FLOOR, OBTAINED BY RUNNING UNCHANGED CODE TWICE and not by any judgement about what is acceptable: 7.105e-15 maximum absolute difference in the float64 reductions (differing in up to 72% of elements), and ~5 differing elements of 434,380,800 per array in the float32 raw. Cause: `index_add_` on CUDA accumulates atomically and `use_deterministic_algorithms` is enabled nowhere in this repo. SO: a DIFFERS verdict here means the stored artifact was overwritten. It does NOT license comparing a re-run against it by bit-identity -- use the floor above, and note that a criterion loosened after it failed is indistinguishable from one corrected after being shown ill-posed unless the control is actually run (CLAUDE.md gotcha 35). Added as COVERAGE, not rebaselined: `first_baselined_at` is the commit that added it.
tolerance.determinism: FILE INTEGRITY ONLY -- A WEAKER CLAIM THAN EVERY REPRODUCTION ARM IN THIS MANIFEST, AND NOT A REPRODUCTION GUARANTEE. What a REPRODUCES verdict here means: the artifact's bytes on disk are the bytes recorded at `first_baselined_at`. What it does NOT mean: that the code still produces them. AND HERE THAT SECOND CLAUSE IS NOT A CAUTION BUT A FACT: the producing job, slurm/null_determinism_probe.sbatch, passes --eval-cache at line 77, and cache/eval.h5 purges ~2026-08-23. After that date these eight documents cannot be regenerated by any version of the code, on any device, until the activation cache is rebuilt. NO NUMERIC TOLERANCE IS STATED AND NONE COULD BE MEASURED: a control-measured floor needs a producing re-run, which is exactly what is unavailable. THE POOLED NULL'S MEASURED FLOOR IS NOT TRANSFERRED HERE. It was measured on null_pilot_k.h5's float64 reductions and float32 raw arrays; these are JSON difference summaries, a different artifact in a different format, and same code family is not same artifact (CLAUDE.md gotcha 35). WHAT THESE EIGHT UNIQUELY HOLD, and the reason the arm exists: the three committed tolerance figures are in git in four places, so this arm does NOT protect the figures -- it protects their DERIVATION. The 446,308/614,400 decomposition behind 'up to 72%', the per-array 1+4 behind '~5 of 434,380,800', git_sha 002673b and both source paths live nowhere else once $SCRATCH/determinism_probe/ purges ~2026-09-04. SO: a DIFFERS verdict means the stored artifact was overwritten; a MISSING_NOW verdict means it was deleted, which is the live risk while project sits at 92% of quota. Neither licenses any comparison of a re-run against this baseline, because there can be no re-run. Added as COVERAGE, not rebaselined: `first_baselined_at` is the commit that added it, and 'has reproduced since' cannot be back-dated to a period when nothing was watching.
tolerance.build_inputs: FILE INTEGRITY ONLY -- THIS IS A WEAKER CLAIM THAN EVERY OTHER ARM IN THIS MANIFEST, AND IT IS NOT A REPRODUCTION GUARANTEE. What a REPRODUCES verdict here means: the artifact's bytes on disk are the bytes recorded at `first_baselined_at`. What it does NOT mean: that the code still produces it. It catches a silent overwrite, a partial write, and an unrecorded regeneration -- the three things that actually threaten these six between now and the classification build, and a prior session did overwrite an artifact in place rather than writing to a new path. It catches CODE DRIFT NOT AT ALL. WHY NOT A NUMERIC TOLERANCE: five of the six cannot be re-derived bit-for-bit, and a control-measured floor for them needs a producing re-run this session was not authorised to launch (the experimental null alone cost 20 CPU tasks at ~12.5 h each). THE POOLED NULL'S MEASURED FLOOR IS NOT TRANSFERRED TO ANY TARGET ON THIS ARM. It was measured on null_pilot_k.h5 via a CUDA path whose index_add_ atomics are the stated mechanism; four of these six were produced on CPU, where whether index_add_ varies run to run is UNKNOWN and is NOT assumed in either direction. Same code family is not same artifact (CLAUDE.md gotcha 35), and 'the CUDA argument does not apply on CPU' would be a mechanism claim standing in for a measurement (gotcha 22). SO: a DIFFERS verdict here means the stored artifact was overwritten and the build's input is not what it was. It licenses NO comparison of a re-run against this baseline by bit-identity. PRECEDENT: the pre-migration git bundle is verified by file-integrity against a recorded hash rather than by a rebuild, for the same reason. Added as COVERAGE, not rebaselined: `first_baselined_at` is the commit that added it, and 'has reproduced since' cannot be back-dated to a period when nothing was watching.
tolerance.inferential_primary: FILE INTEGRITY ONLY -- A WEAKER CLAIM THAN EVERY REPRODUCTION ARM IN THIS MANIFEST, AND NOT A REPRODUCTION GUARANTEE. What a REPRODUCES verdict here means: the artifact's bytes on disk are the bytes recorded at `first_baselined_at`. What it does NOT mean: that the code still produces it, or that re-running the join would return these numbers. It catches a silent overwrite, a partial write and an unrecorded regeneration. It catches CODE DRIFT NOT AT ALL. WHY NOT A NUMERIC TOLERANCE: no control run of this artifact has ever been made, so no floor has been MEASURED for it, and a floor is the only thing that would license a numeric criterion (gotcha 35). Re-running the join to measure one is a real job (20813625: 7 m 22 s, 96 GiB, 8 cpu) and BM was not authorised to launch it. THE POOLED NULL'S MEASURED FLOOR IS NOT TRANSFERRED HERE, on exactly the grounds `build_inputs` states: it was measured on a different artifact via a CUDA index_add_ path, this one was produced on CPU, and 'the CUDA argument does not apply on CPU' would be a mechanism claim standing in for a measurement (gotcha 22). SO: a DIFFERS verdict here means the stored artifact was overwritten and the inferential primary is not what it was. It licenses NO comparison of a re-run against this baseline by bit-identity. Added as COVERAGE, not rebaselined: `first_baselined_at` is the commit that added it, and 'has reproduced since' cannot be back-dated to a period when nothing was watching.
tolerance.build_outputs: FILE INTEGRITY ONLY -- A WEAKER CLAIM THAN EVERY REPRODUCTION ARM IN THIS MANIFEST, AND NOT A REPRODUCTION GUARANTEE. What a REPRODUCES verdict here means: each artifact's bytes on disk are the bytes recorded at its `first_baselined_at`. What it does NOT mean: that the code still produces them, or that re-running any of these builds would return these numbers. It catches a silent overwrite, a partial write and an unrecorded regeneration. It catches CODE DRIFT NOT AT ALL. WHY THIS ARM EXISTS: the other five arms watch INPUTS, NULLS, the PREDICTOR, the LABEL STORE and the INFERENTIAL PRIMARY. Established by enumerating the twenty committed targets rather than assumed, NOT ONE was a build OUTPUT -- so the artifacts the paper's concept-level, classification, grid, paired-arm and decomposition numbers are read from were watched by nothing (amendment BY Part A). WHY A NEW ARM RATHER THAN WIDENING ONE: `build_inputs`' tolerance reasons about a fixed set of six and `inferential_primary`'s about a single artifact, so extending either would silently change what a committed tolerance was written about -- the same reason BM created an arm instead of widening BB's. WHY NOT A NUMERIC TOLERANCE: no control run exists for nine of the eleven, so no floor has been MEASURED for them, and a measured floor is the only thing that would license a numeric criterion (gotcha 35). THE POOLED NULL'S MEASURED FLOOR IS NOT TRANSFERRED TO ANY TARGET ON THIS ARM, on exactly the grounds `build_inputs` states: it was measured on a different artifact via a CUDA `index_add_` path, these were produced on CPU, and 'the CUDA argument does not apply on CPU' would be a mechanism claim standing in for a measurement (gotcha 22). WHERE INDEPENDENT-RECOMPUTATION EVIDENCE DOES EXIST IT IS RECORDED IN THE TARGET'S OWN `why` FIELD WITH ITS SCOPE, and it is scoped to a DATASET rather than a file in both cases -- BT-C2's 40/40 bit-identical BH `reject`, and BY's bit-identical recomputation of the decomposition's 95th-percentile thresholds and D vectors. A sha256 over the whole file does not verify either, and must not be described as doing so. SO: a DIFFERS verdict here means the stored artifact was overwritten and a number the paper reads is not what it was. It licenses NO comparison of a re-run against this baseline by bit-identity. Added as COVERAGE, not rebaselined: `first_baselined_at` is the commit that added it, and 'has reproduced since' cannot be back-dated to a period when nothing was watching.

identity.device_class_condition: A BIT_IDENTICAL tolerance also asserts a DEVICE CLASS. Measured at BB12.3: the MNN counts differ in 4 of 204,800 cells (2.1e-6) between a CPU partition and rtx_5000_ada, consistent with cosine similarities landing within float32 rounding of theta = 0.70. A target marked 'MNN_COSINE_THRESHOLD' that reports DIFFERS after being regenerated on another device class has NOT necessarily drifted -- and the answer is to reproduce it on rtx_5000_ada, never to widen the tolerance. 'NOT_ESTABLISHED' means no device-sensitivity measurement exists for that target; it does NOT mean device-independent. 'TOPK_GATHER_NEAR_TIE' (amendment BK) names the OTHER measured mechanism: the TopK gather selects a different feature set on CPU than on rtx_5000_ada because near-tie pre-activations swap under a float32 matmul -- 9,018 of 204,800 (seed, feature) fire_counts pairs, 4.40%, for the same checkpoint on the same rows (gotcha 36). It is a DIFFERENT mechanism from the MNN cosine threshold and is named separately so a DIFFERS verdict says which one to look at. A target's own 'build_device_class' says WHAT TO REPRODUCE ON and is the field to read; where a target states none, 'rtx_5000_ada' above is the documented default and is NOT a per-target measurement. 'build_device_provenance' says how that value was established, and INFERRED_FROM_PRODUCING_JOB_LOGS is not MEASURED.
